steps.speaker: Sinner with huge sword
steps.content: Gonna kill... kill you!
You can hear the muffled throaty voice through the crack on her helmet. She struggles to walk toward you, but this time Hella jumps out, climbing over the top of the car.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Don't make me say it again, get away from him!
steps.female_content: Don't make me say it again, get away from her!

steps.content: She smashes the pursuer's helmet hard with her steel bar, fighting back the already injured enemy.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: There will be more of them coming, we must get out of here soon.

steps.speaker: Honk
steps.content: Honk!
In front of you, an off-roader from the Legion has suddenly started. A familiar cap sticks out of the car window, its wearer waving at you.

steps.speaker: Driver
steps.content: Yo. The car I've snatched this time ain't too bad, wanna get in?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: You're... still alive?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Humph. Way to go.

steps.speaker: Driver
steps.content: As civil servants, I'm sure you've got enough money for the payment. Let's go.
The car shoots off along the desert highway. You turn back to find the pursuer you've left behind and see the woman chasing you straightening up slowly.
Her helmet is split into two halves. Half of it falls off. Her loose white hair is flying amid the flames, and those bloodthirsty red eyes are gazing in the direction you're going.
You hear Hella exclaim softly, her voice filled with shock.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...Ninety-nine?
Hella doesn't answer, only stares at the woman in a daze. You don't press further. A different kind of extremely uneasy premonition is clutching your heart now.
You have properly shaken off the pursuer behind you and are heading into the dark desert along the highway, but that doesn't mean you're safe from danger now.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Why aren't they coming after us... They've been chasing us for the whole night, why stop now?

The car is belting down the road in the dark, the headlights shining on a small patch of flying sand. You have a feeling that this is not an escape... More like you're constantly approaching something fearsome lurking ahead of you.
You suddenly understand the true meaning of this premonition.
But it's already too late.
A figure suddenly barges into the headlights' range. It's impossible to brake at this distance. You rush into her at high speed, but she doesn't seem to want to dodge at all.
She faces the collision head-on. For a second, you even think... she's smiling.

steps.speaker: Driver
steps.content: No way...
It's her!

At the moment of contact, the woman swings her fist hard at the car's front. Under the intense impact, both the car and you get thrown up in the air. Your vision blackens and you lose consciousness...
